title: GTA 4 vs GTA 6 day one is insane #gta6 #shorts
description: GTA IV day-one figures per GameSpot; GTA VI per Take-Two and a Sensor Tower estimate.

scenes.say: GTA 4 versus GTA 6 on day one. Look at this jump.
GTA 4 made three hundred ten million on day one. GTA 6? Three point seven nine billion, counting preorders. And both go up to six wanted stars.
GTA 5 was the only one stuck at five.
